mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty", note AS "note", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate" FROM production_schedule WHERE schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT id AS "id", 'manual' AS "source", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = logistics_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = logistics_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(actual_qty, order_qty) AS "orderQty", note AS "note", CASE WHEN actual_qty IS NOT NULL AND actual_qty != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "shipped" FROM logistics_schedule WHERE schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT p.id AS "id", 'production' AS "source", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = p.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = p.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(p.logistics_actual_qty, p.actual_qty, p.order_qty) AS "orderQty", p.note AS "note", CASE WHEN p.logistics_actual_qty IS NOT NULL AND p.logistics_actual_qty != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "shipped" FROM production_schedule p WHERE p.logistics_date = #{date} AND (COALESCE(p.ship_confirmed, 0) != 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_schedule l WHERE l.lot_id = p.id)) ORDER BY p.id
